{{Top|leg}}
'''Sriluur spaceport''' was the main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]]. A [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] gang was stationed there, and at one point attempted to use an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] they had somehow acquired for extortion purposes against various spacers before [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] proceeded to blow its back legs off with a concussion missile.
